issue_request: FHIR-31756 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request raised against R4. It asked to correct R4B ballot-intro wording that said the Evidence-Based Medicine resources were "extremely draft" and criticized low or no implementation in the EBM and following medication section. The final resolution accepted that the resources were in development and explained that they had since received significant EBM-on-FHIR community input, implementation experience, R4B/R5 changes, and deprecation or move notices.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-31756 was found. Git history shows 15328ce332 introduced the exact historical R4B ballot-intro sentence, while later EBM and ballot-note commits revised the Evidence and Statistics page and removed the old R4B paragraph from current ballot materials. The 2025 Jira applied comment marks the issue applied because the relevant resources changed significantly since initial R4B publication.
additional_context: Current source no longer contains the challenged "extremely draft" sentence or the associated R4B "no uptake" paragraph. Current R6 ballot notes list immature artifacts moved out to IGs, including Citation, and the active Clinical Reasoning Evidence and Statistics page links to the EBMonFHIR project and IG, states Citation moved to the EBM IG, and states EvidenceReport was replaced by a Composition profile. The Evidence and Statistics page is in the build hierarchy and the relevant EBM resources are active in fhir.ini. The only Confluence reference found was the CDS 2025-10-29 agenda asking whether FHIR-31756 was applied; no relevant Zulip or Confluence full-text evidence contradicted the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current build source already satisfies the applied decision and adding new explanatory prose would duplicate current EBM guidance.
